effects.actual_behavior: IAnimatedMonster, not miniboss: shared state/motion and vehicle damage rejection retained. Health50 armor5 resistance .7 float range18 speed .1 float knockback.7 damage11 XP2, configured full-health scaling/persistence. Allied when recipient type POSSESSED_ARMOR_TEAM OR native alliance. Targets Player/golems/retaliation. Every aiStep horizontal wallcollision adds(.1,0,.1); if movement attribute VALUE!=.1 overwrites BASE=.1 (does not remove modifiers). Positive-or-zero parryCooldown starts20 then decrements to-1, never gates parry here. State2 clocks<=13 reject any damage including bypass. Server !gambitParry and (state4 tick>5 OR state5) rejects any damage, transitions8 and marks success before base admission. Goal2 probability28% max39/look20/range3;3 probability28% max65/look40/range3; parry4 probability33% max8/look8/range3; frame5<=25 then success8/failure7; recovery7 max11/counter8 max27, attackDelay admission retained. State2 dash to current target*.25 at12, area tick15; state3 dashes11/33 and area14/36. Sweeps range2.5/height3/arc100/base8, target+one extra. State8 dash5, counter tick8 range2.5/height3/arc180/base13,target+4extras. Area strict distance AND wrapped arc, excludes self/allies; target and extras amount*HauntedKnightDamageMutliplier, extra budget consumed regardless accepted hit. Accepted state8 installs STUN15amp0; no shield/launch. Own update after parent tick. Texture default1/spawnrandom[0,3), saved; palette only. Death state6 counter60 server removal. doMobLoot own material loop reevaluates random upper bound EACH iteration: variants0/3 iron nextInt(1,5),1 gold nextInt(1,6),2 diamond nextInt(-1,2), i starts0 and uses <= bound; this is not a single uniformly rolled quantity. Native spawnAtLocation override makes these drops glowing/extended. No local drop server guard. Camera/color/animations only presentation.

Starts clearing gambitParry and setting attack state; stop8 on success else5 ignoring endstate, cooldown0.
